actions.text: Meet with Doug and Randy to agree SRS fees, scope of work, and schedule.
actions.notes: Workbook note: SRS fees calculation `$665,000 - $591,996 = $73,004`. Confirm who owes/receives this amount and whether it affects Dakota/DRS scope.

actions.text: Try to obtain permit on line
actions.notes: Do before fees or distribution of field set.

actions.text: Obtain Dakota information for permit.
actions.notes: Workbook note: Dave to get info from Randy. Dakota action also lists hauler info. Date appears past due as of 2026-08-17. Confirm whether SRS must provide or pay for waste-hauler information/arrangements.

actions.text: Review final fee balance.
actions.notes: Confirm who pays LADBS fees and reimbursement path.

actions.text: Pay final fees, download payment receipt, issue/pull permit, download issued permit and building/permit card.
actions.notes: Split into substeps if payment authority is not already clear.

actions.text: Download stamped approved plans, approval letters, calculations, and reports.
actions.notes: These are the official field-control documents.

actions.text: Create a controlled field set: issued permit, permit card, stamped approved plans, approval letters, calculations, reports, and applicable conditions.
actions.notes: Confirm distribution list: Dakota, owner/client, SRS, inspectors, civil/survey, plumber if relevant.

actions.text: Create project schedule for client.
actions.notes: Include permit issue, mobilization, layout, Dig Alert, BMPs, drilling/excavation, inspections/testing, concrete/grout if any, milestones, and closeout.

actions.text: Set up preconstruction meeting.
actions.notes: Attendees likely Dave/DRS, Dakota, owner/client, SRS, inspectors, civil/survey, plumber, and any LADBS/soils reps if appropriate.

actions.text: Hold preconstruction meeting.
actions.notes: Use meeting agenda in Section 4.

actions.text: Determine required inspectors and testing agencies.
actions.notes: Include LADBS inspections, deputy soils inspection, concrete/grout testing if required, and any special inspection tied to approved plans.

actions.text: Hire Feffer as registered deputy inspector for soils.
actions.notes: Confirm spelling/entity, availability, scope, rates, report distribution, and required LADBS credentials.

actions.text: Determine and hire concrete testing inspector for grout/concrete if required.
actions.notes: Workbook wording: "Hire concrete testing inspectors for grout?" Confirm if grout/concrete is in approved scope.

actions.text: Establish inspection/testing payment and recordkeeping process.
actions.notes: Yellow-highlighted Dakota exclusion: scheduling/payment for inspections, permits, fees, deputy soils, concrete inspections, concrete testing, record keeping, and reports are by others. Dave's SRS list says SRS should coordinate any permit responsibilities.

actions.text: Hire civil/surveyor to stake property lines per GPI.
actions.notes: Action list names Payan Surveying Inc., phone 951-356-6456. Confirm scope: property lines, wall line, offsets, center-of-hole locations, elevations, depths, benchmarks, and as-built points. Dave/DRS will help coordinate what needs survey and recommended offsets.

actions.text: Investigate timing for Dig Alert / utility notification.
actions.notes: Confirm who is legal excavator of record; set required lead time. Dave's SRS list includes utility coordination.

actions.text: Coordinate plumber
actions.notes: Dave's SRS list: SRS to cover potholing and accurate utility location; protection/removal/relocation of utilities above or below ground that may interfere with soil nail installation; power lines too close to be removed or de-energized by others.

actions.text: Confirm permit, approved plans, and building card are on site before work begins.
actions.notes: Required field control.

actions.text: Secure access to 1645 Woods Drive for Dakota staging.
actions.notes: Yellow-highlighted Dakota requirement. Confirm written permission, access route, dates, hours, storage limits, restoration obligations, and insurance requirements.

actions.text: Confirm uninterrupted potable water supply and any hydrant-meter responsibility.
actions.notes: Dave's SRS list: SRS to provide uninterrupted city-pressure potable water near drilling operations and cover any required hydrant meters. Distance is boilerplate and can be adjusted. If an on-site water source is available, leave water responsibility in the owner contract as appropriate.

actions.text: Provide bins or clean-out location for grout/drilling spoils where drilling occurs.
actions.notes: Dakota exclusion; coordinate with waste-hauler and site access.

actions.text: Provide dumpster or designated trash stockpile/export area for Dakota-generated trash.
actions.notes: Dakota excludes trash export by others.

actions.text: Provide storage area, sanitary facilities, security, traffic-control plans, flagmen, and barricades if required.
actions.notes: Yellow-highlighted Dakota exclusion. Dave's SRS list assigns traffic-control plans, flagmen, and barricades to SRS if required. Dakota includes up to two flaggers as required while performing its scope and accepting equipment/material deliveries. Decide what remains outside Dakota's included flagger scope.

actions.text: Coordinate with plumber through owner.
actions.notes: Clarify plumbing conflicts, shutdowns, relocation needs, inspection impacts, and sequencing.

actions.text: Prepare and execute neighbor coordination/notification plan after schedule and laydown plan are known.
actions.notes: Dave's SRS list assigns neighbor coordination to SRS. Include expected start date, working hours, access/parking impacts, noise/vibration expectations, and point of contact.

actions.text: Decide whether to install a site camera and notification process.
actions.notes: Clarify privacy, power/network, monitoring responsibility, and use in progress documentation.

actions.text: Confirm long-lead materials, shop drawings/submittals, delivery dates, and storage/laydown constraints.
actions.notes: Add to schedule once Dakota provides durations.

actions.text: Request required inspections before covering work.
actions.notes: No covered work without required inspection/testing signoff.

actions.text: Establish daily activity report review and dispute process.
actions.notes: Dakota proposal requires owner or representative availability to review/acknowledge daily activity reports; disputes must be made in writing.

actions.text: Establish invoicing flow
actions.notes: Confirm billing contact, PO/job number, invoice cadence, reimbursables, time descriptions, and backup documents.

actions.text: Survey perimeter of Tecco Net location, including offsets where required.
actions.notes: New unique item from Dave's SRS list. DRS will help coordinate the survey scope and recommended offsets.

schedule.title: Permit and field-control documents
schedule.notes: Obtain permit online, resolve final fees, pull permit, and download stamped approved plans, approval letters, calculations, reports, permit, and building card.

schedule.title: Create project schedule for client
schedule.notes: Working schedule to be updated from Dave's dictated actions and dates.

schedule.title: Preconstruction setup and meeting
schedule.notes: Set up and hold preconstruction meeting; confirm attendees, agenda, required inspectors, testing agencies, and recordkeeping responsibilities.

schedule.title: Survey and layout coordination
schedule.notes: Coordinate property lines, wall line, offsets, hole locations, elevations, depths, benchmarks, and as-built needs.

schedule.title: Utilities and site readiness
schedule.notes: Coordinate Dig Alert, utility protection, plumber, access, water, spoils bins, BMPs, permit card, and approved field set before work starts.

schedule.title: Inspection and testing setup
schedule.notes: Confirm LADBS inspections, deputy soils inspection, concrete or grout testing if required, payment path, credentials, and report distribution.

schedule.title: Mobilization readiness
schedule.notes: Placeholder schedule bar until Dave dictates detailed mobilization, drilling, inspection, and closeout dates.
